cards.text: David's heading home after Absalom's rebellion, and the men of Israel and the men of Judah just had a heated argument over who has more claim to the king. Right then, a worthless man named Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjamite, happens to be there. And friend, this man has TIMING, because he blows the ram's horn and starts shouting.

cards.question: Sheba shouts that Israel has no share in David, no inheritance in Jesse's son. So what's he calling the men of Israel to do?
One horn, one shout. Which group deserts David to follow Sheba?
True or false: The men of Judah stay by King David all the way from the Jordan to Jerusalem.

cards.text: Back at his palace in Jerusalem, David puts the ten concubines he left to take care of the palace in a house under guard. He provides for them, but he no longer sleeps with them.

cards.question: David's ten concubines are confined until the day they die, living as ___.

cards.text: Now, about that rebellion. David calls in Amasa, the man he chose to lead his army in place of Joab, and gives him a job with a deadline: summon the men of Judah, and be there himself.

cards.question: How much time does David give Amasa to summon the men of Judah?
True or false: Amasa gets back to David within the time David gave him.

cards.text: Amasa's running late. And friend, I spent YEARS in a drawer, so I know a thing or two about not showing up.
David can't wait, so he turns to Abishai, Joab's brother: "Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom."

cards.question: David tells Abishai to take his men and chase Sheba down. What is David afraid Sheba will find if they wait?

cards.text: Out of Jerusalem they march: Joab's men, the Cherethites, the Pelethites and ALL the mighty men. Sheba blew one horn, and now the whole guest list is coming after him.
At the great stone in Gibeon, Amasa catches up and joins them. Joab's dressed for battle with a dagger strapped to his belt, and as he steps forward, he slips the dagger from its sheath.

cards.question: True or false: With that dagger loose, Joab walks up and greets Amasa like a brother.

cards.text: "Are you well, my brother?" Joab asks, and he grabs Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him. Amasa is not on guard against the dagger in Joab's hand.

cards.question: Amasa isn't watching the dagger in Joab's hand. What happens to Amasa?

cards.text: Then Joab and Abishai go right back to chasing Sheba. One of Joab's young men stands near Amasa and calls out: whoever favors Joab and whoever is for David, follow Joab.

cards.question: Amasa's body is lying in the middle of the road, and when the troops reach it, they ___.
True or false: Once the young man drags Amasa's body into a field and throws a garment over it, all the men go on with Joab after Sheba.

cards.text: Meanwhile, Sheba passes through all the tribes of Israel, and the Berites gather together and follow him. This man is collecting followers the way I collected DUST in that drawer.

cards.question: Joab's troops finally catch up and trap Sheba inside a city. Which city?
Joab's troops build a siege ramp against the city's outer rampart. True or false: They also start battering the wall to topple it.

cards.text: The wall is taking a beating. Then, from inside the city, someone calls out, "Listen! Listen!"

cards.question: The voice calling from the city belongs to a wise ___ who asks to speak with Joab.

cards.text: His army was just battering the city WALL, and now Joab comes near and tells her he's listening. That's my Mags energy, friend: when she talks, EVERYBODY stops.
She says, "Long ago they used to say, 'Seek counsel at Abel,' and that is how disputes were settled." In other words, this town is famous for TALKING things out.

cards.question: The wise woman says she's among the peaceable and faithful in Israel, and her city is a mother in Israel. What does she ask Joab?

answers.text: Why he would swallow up the LORD's inheritance
Why he would break his oath to the king
Why he would defy the word of the king

cards.text: Joab answers, "Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!" He tells her Sheba son of Bichri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against King David.

cards.question: So Joab has no fight with the city itself. What does he want from it before he'll leave?
True or false: The wise woman promises Joab the city will hand Sheba over to him alive.

cards.text: She takes her wise counsel to all the people, and they cut off Sheba's head and throw it to Joab. A whole army hammering on the wall, and one wise woman settles it with a CONVERSATION.

cards.question: Sheba started this whole rebellion by blowing a ram's horn. Now Joab blows one. What do Joab's men do?

answers.text: Each go to their own home
March in and take the city

cards.question: True or false: When it's all over, Joab goes back to King David in Jerusalem.

cards.text: The chapter wraps up with a list of David's officials, from the recorder to the scribe to the priests. And right at the top of that list is Joab, over the whole army of Israel.
